goals.title: Fix the confirmed YOLO fusion/RViz causes. Deliverable: scripts/hyu-d...
goals.objective: Fix the confirmed YOLO fusion/RViz causes. Deliverable: scripts/hyu-docker fusion and fusion-bg must pass bbox_source:=yolov8 so perception_baseline launches yolov8_bbox_node and routes /yolo_bounding_boxes, and graph_slam.rviz must enable the /cones/viz Fusion Cones display. Tier: HEAVY because this touches ROS launch/RViz integration. Success criteria: C1 RED then GREEN parsed CLI evidence for scripts/hyu-docker showing fusion/fusion-bg before change omit bbox_source:=yolov8 and after change include it in both commands, evidence .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-fix-c1.txt. C2 RED then GREEN parsed config evidence for graph_slam.rviz showing /cones/viz Fusion Cones before change disabled and after change Enabled/Value true, evidence .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-fix-c2.txt. C3 partial runtime launch-argument evidence showing perception_baseline launch accepts bbox_source and yolo_bbox_topic and cleanup receipt, evidence .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-fix-c3.txt. Constraints: smallest production change only; do not modify unrelated files; do not commit unless explicitly requested.

successCriteria.scenario: CLI parsed script scenario: run python3 parser over scripts/hyu-docker. PASS after fix if both fusion and fusion-bg command bodies contain bbox_source:=yolov8, with RED evidence from .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-fix-red.txt showing both were false before the patch.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-fix-c1.txt: C1_PASS=True; RED showed fusion/fusion-bg omitted bbox_source:=yolov8, GREEN shows both command bodies include bbox_source:=yolov8. cleanup: no runtime process spawned; only evidence file written

successCriteria.scenario: Parsed RViz config scenario: run python3 parser over eufs_sim/eufs_launcher/config/graph_slam.rviz. PASS after fix if the Fusion Cones block targeting /cones/viz has Enabled true and Value true, with RED evidence from .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-fix-red.txt showing it was disabled before the patch.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-fix-c2.txt: C2_PASS=True; RED showed /cones/viz Fusion Cones disabled, GREEN exact Fusion Cones block has Enabled:true and Value:true with no false fields in block. cleanup: no runtime process spawned; only evidence file written

successCriteria.scenario: Partial runtime launch-argument scenario: run source install/setup.bash with ROS_LOG_DIR under .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/ros-log-fix and ros2 launch eufs_perception_baseline perception_baseline.launch.py --show-args. PASS if output includes bbox_source default simulated, yolo_bbox_topic default /yolo_bounding_boxes, and the command exits 0 without starting ROS/RViz/simulator processes.
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-fix-c3.txt: ros2 launch --show-args exited 0 using workspace ROS_LOG_DIR and output includes bbox_source plus yolo_bbox_topic; .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-fix-qa.txt: bash -n exit 0 and pytest launch wiring 4 passed; Docker smoke blocked by daemon socket permission before starting containers. cleanup: no ROS launch, RViz, simulator, container, or persistent process was started
